title: Registry: Harbor users + project/robot scope (acl list)
description: Runs `nexus acl registry list`. Lists the Harbor users via /api/v2.0/users (admin auth from Vault KV) and surfaces the project + robot-account counts. Under OIDC SSO (auth_mode=oidc_auth) users onboard on login, so a freshly-rebuilt tier shows the scope summary with no onboarded users yet; the built-in admin is revoke-protected.

observe.what: the Harbor users (sysadmin flag shown) + a scope pseudo-row "(harbor scope: N projects, M robot accounts)"; admin flagged protected when present

whatProves: RegistryAdapter.AclAsync lists Harbor users through /api/v2.0/users (admin from Vault KV nexus/registry/harbor-admin) and enriches with project + robot counts; the built-in admin is revoke-protected.
